The '''Bantu system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Emmo sector/Legends|Emmo sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the phenomenon known as the [[rainbow sunsets of Bantu]].<ref name="PhraseBook">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[rainbow sunsets of Bantu]]|system=Bantu [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bantu [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
